    "70a71b84: ;Writes a prompt with the field label",
    "990933c5: ;Quits the subroutine",
    "80a83ea2: ;Outputs the current value of Y, and starts a new line if it exceeds 45 characters",
    "49fc2217: ;If the field value exceeds 19 characters, and it's not a word-processing field, and it's either free text or a key field, it branches to the RW^DIR2 subroutine to handle long field values",
    "6d5cd17e: ;If the field is not a word-processing field, and it is a multiple, it displays a \"No Editing\" message if the current subfile entry is unavailable",

    "5845b4dd: ;Quits the subroutine",
    "9fc449cd: ;Deletes the current subfile entry and increments the entry counter",
    "b814c20e: ;Branches to the next subfile entry",
    "06b93e60: ;If there is a current entry, it branches to PR to process it; otherwise, it outputs a prompt and reads user input",
    "ef30163f: ;If response is null, don't reask if 'NO RE-ASK' in data dict.",
    "4dcc47f6: ;If response starts with ?, go to READER HELP",
    "4de56f51: ;If response is @, go to READER FOR XMIT",
    "6059a981: ;If LAYGO for subfield and developer edit word for subfile",
    "26fc1ec8: ;Set dic code & execute dic('s') if node present",
    "4a8b7652: ;Find next unmatched multiple from dir string",
    "22c2d05e: ;Append match to output var & remove match from input var",
    "89e8c63d: ;'P'ick list",
    "3f6847fc: ;Not a number (unless 'NUMBERVALUED') error trap",
    "eaf8f9e1: ;Trim $0 from number in dir string if subfile has no 'compute' code",
    "a23b425b: ;Execute xecute code",
    "fa9fa75d: ;Save values & re-order multiple if relinking active",
    "14eee525: ;Bad branching, ???",
    "4d43d09f: ;Set 'BAD' x & quit",
    "d9c91de2: ;Reader help",
    "9c54829b: ;Set data elements for current field.",
    "ef6cb3b3: ;If DE(DQ) is NULL, branch to either RD or A based on conditions.",
    "318447a7: ;If DQ(DQ,2) exists, execute code in DQ(DQ,2) and go to RP.",
    "59ecf076: ;If DG contains 'P' and the referenced global node exists, set X to the value at ^(0),U,2 and branch to RP if ^(Y,0) is undefined. Otherwise, set Y and DG to respective values and go to R.",
    "0d00035f: ;If DG contains 'V' and the referenced global node exists, set X to the value at ^(0),U,2 and branch to RP if ^(+Y,0) is undefined. If the DD global node for the file exists, set DG and X to respective values and go to R.",
    "54ed1ebb: ;If DG contains 'D', execute code in ^DD('DD'). If DG contains 'S', set Y to the piece of X delimited by ';Y;'.",
    "d8c5ea55: ;Write output, set X to DE(DQ) if null, and branch based on conditions.",
    "0a0f303f: ;If DV does not contain 'I' or '#', go to RD.",
    "cac2b9b3: ;Execute code in ^DIE0, then go to RD if X is defined, else go to PR.",
    "47185e76: ;End of routine.",
    "b8643432: ;Set routine name and initial value of DQ.",
    "0250187c: ;Set field attributes for the PRIMARY PHYSICIAN field (.09) in file 393.",
    "4d64599e: ;Set DU to the global root for the VA(200 file.",
    "ba24a54c: ;Set X to the value of DGJT1PH.",
    "8323f27d: ;Set Y to the value of X.",
    "0c12c32c: ;If the data has been edited, validate the new value",
    "64b6dee5: ;If there is a value, quit. Otherwise, delete the field",
    "717d9da4: ;(No additional logic for this cross-reference)",
    "498f8aa2: ;Branch to the next block of code"
  ]
}
